metadata.description: AI-assisted project governance scaffold with mandatory quality gates

plugins.name: forge-kit-adapt
plugins.description: forge-adapt skill: analyses your project, suggests the right forge-kit components to adapt to your needs, and installs them for you

plugins.name: forge-kit-governance
plugins.description: ticket-gate agent, gate-ticket command, block-dashes hook, closing-sessions, working-overnight and ticket-gate-reference skills, overnight-continue, overnight-guard, no-poll-loops, masked-exit-advisory and forge-write-consent hooks

plugins.name: forge-kit-roadmap
plugins.description: Rolling wave planning: docs/roadmap.md owns which phases exist, the host owns which phase each ticket is in, and four rules are enforced rather than remembered. Optional; needs forge-kit-devops.

plugins.name: forge-kit-review
plugins.description: code-reviewer, architect-review, code-simplifier and coding-standards-auditor agents, and /full-review with its bounded iteration contract. Needs forge-kit-security.

plugins.name: forge-kit-security
plugins.description: security-auditor and api-security-tester agents, the OWASP API checklist and opt-in privacy-regime skills, the leak-guard for a repo about to go public, and an opt-in hook that scans gh issue and PR text before it posts.

plugins.name: forge-kit-testing
plugins.description: mutation-sweep: the defect class line coverage cannot see, which is a covered line whose test cannot fail. The TDD and test-automation agents were retired in favour of wshobson/agents, which ships the originals.

plugins.name: forge-kit-devops
plugins.description: dep-auditor, health-check agents; /ci-health command; find-dead-code, release, release-automation, forge-host, github-to-forgejo, context-budget, usage-report skills; block-legacy-host-push hook
